name: membership-card-png
title_zh: 把会员卡补办流程变成一张可展示的 PNG 图
tagline_zh: 会员卡丢了、坏了、被偷了？不用等实体卡寄到，脚本直接把补办后的卡号渲染成数字卡片，当场就能亮在屏幕上。
tagline_en: Lost, damaged, or stolen card? Skip the wait for plastic—render the reissued card as a PNG you can show on screen.
desc_en: Generate a digital BlastPass membership card as a PNG image by running the bundled card_png.py script. Use when a member self-serves a lost/stolen/damaged card replacement, or any time a card needs to be shown on screen (vs. printed). The skill takes the member details returned by the Membership MCP (get_membership) plus the new_card_serial returned by reissue_card and passes them as command-line
why_zh: 它把 Membership MCP 的查询结果和补办序列号直接喂给本地 Python 脚本。
why_en: Feeds get_membership output plus the new serial straight into a local Python script—one command yields a card image, no design.
limit_zh: 只认 Membership MCP 返回的字段结构，且本机要有 Python 3 和 Pillow。
limit_en: Requires Python 3 + Pillow; only accepts fields from Membership MCP. Output is a static PNG—no QR, magstripe, or interactivity, and not print-ready.
